lead: Soundarya was an Indian actor, born on 18 July 1972 in Mulbagal.
She died on 17 April 2004 in Bengaluru at the age of 31.
She has 37 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Nandi Award and Filmfare Awards South.
The sections that follow break down Soundarya's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
